includes: required queues and protocol-independent support logic

secondary_boundary.purpose: Explain where cost comes from; never substitute for the primary competition result.

execution_statuses.meaning: The declared command and checks completed successfully.
The workload or acceptance check ran and did not meet its declared expectation.
An attempted run could not complete; the exact blocker must be retained.
No qualifying run exists. This is neither a pass nor a failure.
The metric genuinely does not apply; a written reason is required.

value_provenance.meaning: Produced by a retained command, tool identity and artifact in this repository.
Calculated from measured values with the formula and inputs retained.
Reported by a pinned external source under different implementation conditions; context only.

comparison_rule: Only compare values with the same boundary, workload, clock, source revision, toolchain, unit and evidence stage.
